pathways.title: IMI KIS (Kartu Izin Start) pathway
steps: Register IMI membership (KTA) via MyIMI at https://myimi.id (see also https://www.imi.id/registrasi/)
Affiliate with an IMI club as required for competition
Obtain KIS (Kartu Izin Start) / the competition licence grade listed on MyIMI for the event
Complete medical requirements for that tier
Complete any required rider course or briefings and enter IMI-sanctioned events (Kejurnas Motoprix, MRS, etc.)
pathways.notes: High-level only — no invented pasal / clause numbers. MyIMI is the 2026 membership/KIS deep-link. Confirm season grade labels on the portal.
